fields.power: Raspberry Pi 5 1GB via 5 V / 5 A USB-C; ESP32, amplifier, lights and motor supplies — final voltages TBD
fields.outputs: Audio, lights, motor, tuning/station behavior, startle sequence, self-test confirmation
fields.trigger: Power-on self-test; standby until 6:45 PM local; show and armed-haunted mode; configured startle trigger — TBD; Hub override
fields.controller: Raspberry Pi 5 1GB primary controller; ESP32 I/O coprocessor optional
fields.network: HollowNet via Queue Zone Controller; wired Ethernet preferred for Pi, Wi-Fi fallback
fields.notes: Confirmed design: on power-up, run a startup sequence that exercises sound, lights and motor and reports component results, then enter standby. At 6:45 PM local time, enter show mode and arm the haunted startle behavior. Between startles, continue the currently selected station and settings. The Hub must edit settings and schedule, select mode, enable/disable the scene, run tests, control volume and playback, trigger a service startle, and show online state, current mode, playback state and self-test results. Exact feedback sensors for proving sound, light and motor operation remain TBD. Hardware assignment confirmed from supplied photos: use the available Raspberry Pi 5 1GB locally for media, scheduling and scene state. The Pi can also handle dial, trigger, light and motor commands through suitable ADC/input and load-driver hardware; an ESP32 remains optional as a real-time/fault-isolation I/O coprocessor. Do not use the original Raspberry Pi Model B as the show-critical radio controller; retain it as an unassigned spare or legacy board. The separate Raspberry Pi 5 4GB is reserved for the Main Hub.

fields.notes: Queue control boundary for the Haunted Radio. It must expose enable, standby, show and armed-haunted modes; editable 6:45 PM schedule and scene settings; volume and playback controls; service test/startle commands; and online, mode, playback and startup-self-test status to the Main Hub. The radio must retain its local schedule and show behavior if the Hub connection is unavailable.
